character.zh: 重刹区、低速牵引力（traction）和后轮胎管理。
character.en: Heavy stops, low-speed traction, and rear-tyre management.

challenge.zh: 连续制动区让出弯和后轮温度在一段赛程中都很关键。
challenge.en: Repeated braking zones make exits and rear temperatures matter through a stint.

advice.zh: 保持直线制动，耐心松开踏板，出弯保护后轮。
advice.en: Brake in a straight line, release the pedal patiently, and protect the rear tyres on exit.

observation.zh: 官方强调高温与轮胎衰退。
observation.en: The official overview highlights heat and tire degradation.

exercise.zh: 固定油量连续跑短 stint，比较前后段圈速与出弯打滑次数，先追求稳定。
exercise.en: Run a short stint at a fixed starting fuel load; compare early and late pace and exit slides before chasing a peak lap.

character.zh: 长距离负荷弯，搭配技术性很强的末段。
character.en: Long loaded corners plus a mixed technical final sector.

challenge.zh: 持续的横向负荷会在进入较慢末段前考验轮胎平衡。
challenge.en: Sustained lateral load tests tyre balance before the slower final sequence.

advice.zh: 负荷弯里保持转向输入整洁，然后优先保证末段出弯干净。
advice.en: Keep steering inputs tidy in the loaded turns, then prioritize a clean final-sector exit.

observation.zh: 高速长弯、技术中速段与长直道共同考验轮胎和车辆平衡。
observation.en: Fast sweepers, technical medium-speed sections, and the main straight test tires and balance.

exercise.zh: 把高速弯和技术段分开练习，记录持续加方向仍推头的位置，减少额外转向。
exercise.en: Practice sweepers and technical sections separately; note where extra steering adds scrub rather than rotation.

character.zh: 低阻力、极重制动区和长距离全油门。
character.en: Low drag, extreme braking zones, and long full-throttle runs.

challenge.zh: 最大制动时的稳定性必须和直道效率共存。
challenge.en: Stability under the biggest stops must coexist with efficient straight-line running.

advice.zh: 交通中采用保守的制动参考点，并保持进入每条长直道的速度。
advice.en: Use conservative braking references in traffic and preserve momentum onto each long straight.

observation.zh: 官方同时指出 Mulsanne 高速直道及 Indianapolis、Arnage 技术弯的挑战。
observation.en: The overview contrasts the Mulsanne straight with technical Indianapolis and Arnage.

exercise.zh: 分段复习高速末端制动和低速出弯，先建立可重复的制动参照。
exercise.en: Rehearse braking after fast sections and slow-corner exits separately, establishing repeatable braking references.

character.zh: Mistral 直道、Signes 全力攻弯和技术末段。
character.en: Mistral straight, Signes commitment, and a technical final sector.

challenge.zh: 单圈从直线效率切换到高速决心与低速转向。
challenge.en: The lap swings from straight-line efficiency to high-speed commitment and slow rotation.

advice.zh: 逐步建立 Signes 的信心，之后提前制动来整理末段。
advice.en: Build confidence progressively through Signes, then brake early enough to organize the final sector.

observation.zh: 官方介绍 Mistral 直道布局变化，以及蓝红色高摩擦缓冲区。
observation.en: The overview describes Mistral layout changes and abrasive blue/red runoff.

exercise.zh: 先确认当前布局；用赛道内参照练制动，别把彩色缓冲区当正常走线。
exercise.en: Confirm the selected layout and use on-track braking references; keep colored runoff out of your normal line.

character.zh: 上坡制动、高速连续弯和低速牵引区。
character.en: Uphill braking, fast esses, and slow traction zones.

challenge.zh: 开局爬升和连续弯会惩罚不稳定制动，低速出弯则奖励耐心。
challenge.en: The opening climb and esses punish unstable braking, while slow exits reward patience.

advice.zh: 上坡提前放置车身，连续弯平顺变向，低速出弯尽量摆正车身。
advice.en: Place the car early uphill, use smooth direction changes in the esses, and square slow exits.

observation.zh: 第一赛段高速起伏，后半圈更偏技术性，且常面对高温。
observation.en: A fast, undulating first sector contrasts with a technical second half and heat.

exercise.zh: 单练第一段连续换向，避免为一个弯抢速度而破坏后续走线；再检查后半圈出弯。
exercise.en: Practice the opening direction changes as a sequence, then review exits in the technical half.

character.zh: 高速倾斜弯效率、内场牵引力和 Bus Stop 稳定性。
character.en: Banking efficiency, infield traction, and Bus Stop stability.

challenge.zh: 跟车和倾斜弯奖励效率，但内场与 Bus Stop 会惩罚突兀操作。
challenge.en: Drafting and banking reward efficiency, but the infield and Bus Stop punish abrupt inputs.

advice.zh: 在倾斜弯保持干净速度，进入 Bus Stop 路肩前先让车身稳定。
advice.en: Carry clean speed through banking, then settle the car before the Bus Stop kerbs.

observation.zh: 公路布局结合高速椭圆部分与技术内场，需要兼顾两种特性。
observation.en: The road course combines superspeedway speed with a technical infield.

exercise.zh: 分别记录内场损失与高速段表现；调整前后用相同油量比较整圈，而非只看极速。
exercise.en: Track infield losses and fast-section performance separately; compare complete laps at equal fuel, not top speed alone.

character.zh: 超长直道，接着是低速技术性第三段。
character.en: A very long straight followed by a slow technical third sector.

challenge.zh: 直道要求出弯速度，末段则需要受控转向和牵引力。
challenge.en: The straight demands exit speed, then the final sector needs controlled rotation and traction.

advice.zh: 保护通往直道的出弯，然后在技术性第三段放慢手上动作。
advice.en: Protect the exit onto the straight, then slow the hands down for the technical third sector.

observation.zh: 1.47 km 长直道、技术区和多变天气构成主要挑战。
observation.en: A 1.47 km straight, technical sections, and changeable weather define the challenge.

exercise.zh: 反复练习通向主直道的出弯，再在不同天气中重建制动参照。
exercise.en: Repeat the exit onto the main straight, then rebuild braking references in different weather.

character.zh: 狭窄节奏、高路肩、反复制动和牵引力。
character.en: Narrow rhythm, tall kerbs, repeated braking, and traction.

challenge.zh: 赛道宽度有限会放大失误，高路肩也会考验制动与车身稳定。
challenge.en: Limited width magnifies mistakes while tall kerbs challenge braking and composure.

advice.zh: 尊重路肩，提前放置车身，以入弯速度换取出弯牵引力。
advice.en: Respect the kerbs, place the car early, and sacrifice entry speed for traction.

observation.zh: 官方列出 Tamburello、Villeneuve、Tosa、Rivazza 等起伏赛段。
observation.en: The overview highlights an undulating lap through Tamburello, Villeneuve, Tosa, and Rivazza.

exercise.zh: 按这些弯组拆分练习，以连续干净圈验证节奏，再逐步增加速度。
exercise.en: Practice those corner groups separately; establish consecutive clean laps before increasing pace.

character.zh: 起伏、短单圈、中高速混合弯和出弯牵引力。
character.en: Elevation, a short lap, mixed-speed corners, and traction exits.

challenge.zh: 紧凑单圈会放大每次牵引力出弯和地形起伏的影响。
challenge.en: Compressed lap time makes every traction exit and elevation change highly visible.

advice.zh: 出弯优先于激进入弯，并在坡顶保持平台稳定。
advice.en: Prioritize exits over aggressive entries and keep the platform settled over crests.

observation.zh: Senna S、高低起伏和天气变化使走线衔接很重要。
observation.en: The Senna S, elevation changes, and variable weather shape the circuit.

exercise.zh: 把 Senna S 当完整组合练习，记录出口位置；雨天重新检查视线与制动点。
exercise.en: Practice the Senna S as one sequence and record exit position; reassess sightlines and braking in rain.

character.zh: 持续中高速轮胎负荷（tyre load）和轮胎温度。
character.en: Sustained medium/high-speed load and tyre temperature.

challenge.zh: 长距离负荷组合会暴露一段赛程里的轮胎温度与平衡。
challenge.en: Long loaded sequences expose tyre temperature and balance over a full stint.

advice.zh: 避免让负荷轮胎滑动，保持小幅转向修正，并监控温度。
advice.en: Avoid sliding the loaded tyres, keep steering corrections small, and watch temperatures.

observation.zh: 官方记录从白昼跑到灯光下的耐力赛，并提醒存在不同布局。
observation.en: The overview describes endurance racing from daylight into floodlights and multiple layouts.

exercise.zh: 先核对布局，分别练白天和夜间参照，比较相同弯的制动识别是否稳定。
exercise.en: Confirm the layout, then compare daytime and nighttime braking references at the same corners.

character.zh: 最高速度、重刹减速弯和激进路肩。
character.en: Maximum speed, heavy chicane braking, and aggressive kerbs.

challenge.zh: 最高速很重要，但减速弯需要稳定制动和克制的路肩使用。
challenge.en: Top speed matters, but the chicanes demand stable braking and measured kerb use.

advice.zh: 直线制动，不要每个路肩都硬吃，优先保证驶上长直道的出弯。
advice.en: Brake straight, do not attack every kerb, and prioritize exits onto the long straights.

observation.zh: 长直道、复杂减速弯和高速是官方概括的核心特征。
observation.en: Long straights, demanding chicanes, and speed are the core features.

exercise.zh: 分开练直道末端减速和减速弯出口，优先保证接下来直道的起始速度。
exercise.en: Separate end-of-straight braking practice from chicane exits, prioritizing speed onto the following straight.

character.zh: 盲顶、压缩、转向和牵引力。
character.en: Blind crests, compression, rotation, and traction.

challenge.zh: 坡顶会遮挡视线，压缩段会在关键出弯前考验平衡。
challenge.en: Sightlines vanish over crests, and compression tests balance before traction-critical exits.

advice.zh: 在盲顶使用可重复的参考点，等车身稳定后再加油。
advice.en: Use repeatable references over blind crests and delay throttle until the car is settled.

observation.zh: 起伏与多种弯速带来较高滑移能量，对轮胎要求高。
observation.en: Elevation changes and varied corner speeds create high sliding energy and tire demands.

exercise.zh: 在坡顶与落差处减少突然输入；用连续圈检查滑移与胎况，而非只追单圈。
exercise.en: Reduce abrupt inputs around crests and elevation changes; assess sliding over consecutive laps.

character.zh: 颠簸、粗糙制动路面和混凝土接缝上的牵引力。
character.en: Bumps, rough braking surfaces, and traction over concrete seams.

challenge.zh: 路面起伏会打乱制动参考，需要能容忍颠簸的操作平台。
challenge.en: Surface movement disrupts braking references and asks for a platform that tolerates bumps.

advice.zh: 在最差接缝处留余量，渐进制动，让车在你身下自由活动。
advice.en: Leave margin over the worst seams, brake progressively, and let the car move underneath you.

observation.zh: 混凝土跑道遗留的颠簸是官方特别强调的难点。
observation.en: Concrete runway bumps are a defining challenge in the official overview.

exercise.zh: 固定设置比较不同走线的颠簸与方向修正，选出能重复完成的路线。
exercise.en: With setup fixed, compare bumps and steering corrections on alternate lines; favor a repeatable route.

character.zh: 紧凑单圈、频繁交通和反复变向。
character.en: Compact lap, frequent traffic, and repeated direction changes.

challenge.zh: 短单圈里的交通几乎没有补救时间，反复变向则奖励响应灵敏的平台。
challenge.en: Short lap traffic leaves little recovery time, while repeated changes reward a responsive platform.

advice.zh: 提前规划超车，保护出弯速度，每次变向只做一次干净的转向输入。
advice.en: Plan passes early, preserve exit speed, and make one clean steering input per change.

observation.zh: 官方强调快速流畅的走向及 Copse、Maggots–Becketts 等弯。
observation.en: The overview emphasizes flowing speed, Copse, and Maggots–Becketts.

exercise.zh: 确认使用包含这些弯的布局后，连贯练习换向，记录每个出口是否为下一弯留好位置。
exercise.en: On a layout containing these corners, practice linked changes of direction and check positioning for the next turn.

character.zh: 高速空气动力学、起伏、长单圈和多变天气。
character.en: High-speed aero, elevation, a long lap, and variable weather.

challenge.zh: 应对地形起伏的决心必须和天气、轮胎变化平衡。
challenge.en: Commitment through elevation changes must be balanced against weather and tyre variation.

advice.zh: 在变化条件中逐步提速，并在高速压缩处留出余量。
advice.en: Build speed gradually in changing conditions and leave margin at the high-speed compressions.

observation.zh: 海拔起伏、长赛道和快速变化的天气是官方提示的挑战。
observation.en: Elevation, a long lap, and rapidly changing weather are highlighted.

exercise.zh: 按赛段检查抓地变化，先留制动余量，再逐步确认高速弯入口速度。
exercise.en: Check grip by sector, retain braking margin, and build confidence in fast-corner entry speeds progressively.

character.zh: 低速牵引力、起伏和 Corkscrew 组合。
character.en: Low-speed traction, elevation, and the Corkscrew sequence.

challenge.zh: Corkscrew 会迅速下坠，因此车身必须转过来又不牺牲下一处出弯。
challenge.en: The Corkscrew drops away quickly, so the car must rotate without compromising the next exit.

advice.zh: 过坡顶提前制动，在 Corkscrew 用一次平顺转向，并保护牵引力。
advice.en: Brake early over the crest, use one smooth rotation at the Corkscrew, and protect traction.

observation.zh: Corkscrew 是有明显落差的盲左—右组合，赛道缓冲空间有限。
observation.en: The Corkscrew is a blind left-right drop, with limited runoff around the circuit.

exercise.zh: 低速熟悉 Corkscrew 的参照和落点，连跑无越界圈后再提速。
exercise.en: Learn the Corkscrew references and landing at reduced speed, then build pace after consecutive clean laps.

character.zh: 十二个弯角串联起伏、盲坡顶和不断变化的弯道倾角。
character.en: Flowing elevation, blind crests, and changing camber across twelve corners.

challenge.zh: 高速组合会压缩制动和车身放置的决策时间，坡顶又会遮挡视线。
challenge.en: Fast sequences compress braking and placement decisions while sightlines disappear over crests.

advice.zh: 先固定每个盲坡顶后的可重复参照，再逐步缩小安全余量。
advice.en: Build repeatable references beyond each blind crest before reducing the safety margin.

observation.zh: 官方强调连续起伏弯、盲坡顶和不断变化的弯道倾角。
observation.en: The official overview highlights flowing elevation, blind crests, and changing camber.

exercise.zh: 先用保守速度固定盲坡顶后的参照，再以连续干净圈比较起伏路段的一致性。
exercise.en: Fix references beyond blind crests at conservative speed, then compare consistency over consecutive clean laps.

character.zh: 真正的街道赛道，混凝土墙、盲入口和极小容错构成核心特征。
character.en: A true street circuit with concrete walls, blind entries, and minimal margin.

challenge.zh: 重刹和低速转向都贴着墙完成，轻微的车身放置误差也会立刻付出代价。
challenge.en: Heavy braking and slow rotation happen beside walls, so small placement errors carry immediate consequences.

advice.zh: 先建立可重复的制动与贴墙位置，再逐步缩小安全余量。
advice.en: Establish repeatable braking and wall placement before reducing the safety margin.

observation.zh: 这是 LMU 首条真正街道赛道，混凝土墙、盲入口和极小容错构成主要挑战。
observation.en: LMU's first true street circuit is defined by concrete walls, blind entries, and minimal margin.

exercise.zh: 先建立可重复的制动与贴墙位置，再逐步缩小安全余量，不以偶然一圈替代稳定性。
exercise.en: Establish repeatable braking and wall placement before reducing margin; do not trade consistency for one lucky lap.

strength.zh: 平台顺从，制动动作平稳

caution.zh: 允许带着可控的转向不足驾驶
caution.en: can lean into safe understeer

observation.zh: 指南描述入弯推头，也提醒重刹可能让车尾突然滑动。
observation.en: The guide describes entry understeer and possible rear snaps under hard braking.

exercise.zh: 逐步调整拖刹释放，记录转向改善是否伴随车尾不稳。
exercise.en: Vary brake release gradually and note whether improved rotation costs rear stability.

strength.zh: 稳定的前置引擎平衡，兼容路肩（kerb）

caution.zh: 前轮会惩罚过度驾驶
caution.en: front tyres punish overdriving

observation.zh: 指南建议渐进给油并平顺回正，以减少出弯车尾突发滑动。
observation.en: The guide favors progressive throttle and smooth steering unwind to limit exit snaps.

exercise.zh: 用同一弯比较急给油与渐进给油，观察出口速度和修正次数。
exercise.en: Compare throttle ramps at one corner, observing exit speed and steering corrections.

strength.zh: 制动信心足，牵引力（traction）可预测

caution.zh: 需要耐心用油门带动车尾转向
caution.en: throttle rotation needs patience

observation.zh: 指南强调主动转向特性，并提醒长段驾驶时照顾后胎。
observation.en: The guide notes eager rotation and the need to manage rear tires during stints.

exercise.zh: 练习过弯心后平顺回正，用连续圈观察后胎滑移是否增加。
exercise.en: Practice smooth steering unwind after the apex and monitor rear sliding over consecutive laps.

strength.zh: 方向变化灵活，空气动力学平衡
strength.en: agile direction changes and balanced aero

caution.zh: 粗暴路肩可能打乱车身
caution.en: rough kerbs can unsettle it

observation.zh: 指南提醒高速弯、脏空气和雨地中的车尾稳定性。
observation.en: The guide flags rear stability in fast corners, dirty air, and wet conditions.

exercise.zh: 先稳定单车高速段，再留距离练跟车，避免直接照搬单车入口速度。
exercise.en: Establish solo fast-corner consistency, then practice following with space rather than copying solo entry speeds.

strength.zh: 直线速度快，扭矩易于掌控

caution.zh: 车重和前轮负荷在紧凑路段很明显
caution.en: mass and front-tyre load show in tight sectors

observation.zh: 指南认为入弯准备不足会持续推头，建议先充分降速。
observation.en: The guide warns that insufficient preparation and entry speed reduction produce persistent understeer.

exercise.zh: 把减速做在入弯前，比较更早准备是否换来更顺畅的出弯。
exercise.en: Complete more speed reduction before turning and compare the resulting exit quality.

strength.zh: 连续弯反应迅速

caution.zh: 尾部动态需要平顺操作
caution.en: rear movement requires smooth inputs

observation.zh: 指南区分入弯车尾活动与给油后出弯推头，也提醒过度拖刹。
observation.en: The guide distinguishes a mobile rear on entry from power-on exit understeer and warns against excessive trail braking.

exercise.zh: 分开记录入弯和出弯问题，先平顺释放刹车，再调整给油时机。
exercise.en: Log entry and exit problems separately; smooth brake release before adjusting throttle timing.

strength.zh: 稳定感令人安心，V8 输出易用
strength.en: reassuring stability and usable V8 delivery

caution.zh: 极紧凑的方向变化中转向较慢
caution.en: slower rotation in very tight changes

observation.zh: 指南建议重视出口速度，并对路肩保持谨慎。
observation.en: The guide emphasizes exit speed and caution over kerbs.

exercise.zh: 先用少吃路肩的路线稳定跑圈，再单独试验路肩是否真的带来收益。
exercise.en: Build consistency with modest kerb use, then test kerbs one at a time for actual gains.

strength.zh: 空气动力学效率（aero efficiency）高，高速信心足

caution.zh: 低速牵引力和高路肩需要小心
caution.en: low-speed traction and tall kerbs need care

observation.zh: 指南建议直线制动并保持弯速，注意过度转向消耗后胎。
observation.en: The guide favors straight-line braking and carried corner speed, while noting rear-tire costs from oversteer.

exercise.zh: 比较流畅过弯与弯心过度减速，记录后胎滑移而不只看最快圈。
exercise.en: Compare flowing cornering with excessive apex slowing; track rear sliding as well as peak pace.

strength.zh: 制动稳定、牵引力强，平衡容易掌握
strength.en: stable braking, strong traction, and an accessible balance

caution.zh: 紧凑变向中可能出现可控的转向不足
caution.en: tight direction changes can bring safe understeer

observation.zh: 指南强调稳定制动、牵引力和容易掌握的平衡，同时提醒紧凑变向中的推头。
observation.en: The guide highlights stable braking, traction, and an accessible balance, while noting understeer in tight direction changes.

exercise.zh: 先用平顺刹车释放建立稳定入口，再比较减少额外转向是否改善紧凑组合弯。
exercise.en: Establish a stable entry with smooth brake release, then test whether less steering improves tight sequences.

strength.zh: 后置引擎带来牵引力（traction）和转向
strength.en: traction and rotation from the rear-engine layout

caution.zh: 循迹刹车（trail braking）过深可能诱发车尾滑动
caution.en: trail braking can provoke the rear

observation.zh: 指南强调平顺控制重心转移，给油前先让车身稳定并完成转向。
observation.en: The guide stresses smooth weight transfer and settling and rotating the car before acceleration.

exercise.zh: 固定油量练习缓慢衔接松刹与给油，比较长段后半程是否仍能稳定出弯。
exercise.en: Practice a smooth brake-to-throttle transition at fixed fuel and check exit consistency late in a stint.

strength.zh: 车身紧凑，反应灵活

caution.zh: 制动稳定性（braking stability）取决于调校（setup）
caution.en: braking stability is setup-sensitive

observation.zh: 指南描述默认设置下的推头，并建议为制动留出更长距离。
observation.en: The guide describes default-setup understeer and a need for more deliberate braking distance.

exercise.zh: 先采用保守制动参照；确认能持续到达弯心后，再逐步缩短减速距离。
exercise.en: Start with conservative braking references and shorten the zone only after consistently reaching the apex.

strength.zh: 自然吸气响应直接，非混合动力输出可预测
strength.en: naturally aspirated response and predictable non-hybrid delivery

caution.zh: 高速攻弯仍然需要平顺操作
caution.en: high-speed commitment still rewards smooth inputs

observation.zh: 官方车型页将其列为自然吸气、非混合动力 LMH。
observation.en: The official car page identifies it as a naturally aspirated, non-hybrid LMH.

exercise.zh: 先用渐进给油熟悉非混合动力输出，再以连续干净圈调整高速入口。
exercise.en: Learn the non-hybrid delivery with progressive throttle, then tune fast-corner entry over consecutive clean laps.

strength.zh: 平台稳定，过路肩有信心

caution.zh: 低速弯需要耐心让车转起来
caution.en: needs patience to rotate in slow corners

observation.zh: 指南强调冷胎、冷刹车阶段的控制，特别是夜间。
observation.en: The guide highlights cold tires and brakes, particularly during night running.

exercise.zh: 分别记录出站圈与热态圈的制动参照，不把热胎经验直接用于冷胎。
exercise.en: Record out-lap and warmed-up braking references separately instead of transferring warm-tire assumptions.

strength.zh: 制动强，机械牵引力（traction）好

caution.zh: 扭矩可能增加后轮负荷
caution.en: torque can stress the rear tyres

observation.zh: 指南提醒重刹后轮锁死及高速段车尾敏感。
observation.en: The guide warns about rear locking under heavy braking and rear sensitivity at speed.

exercise.zh: 从直线渐进制动开始，记录锁死发生阶段，再练转向与松刹衔接。
exercise.en: Begin with progressive straight-line braking, log where lockups occur, then practice the turn-in transition.

strength.zh: 空气动力学性能和果断转向

caution.zh: 比起修正动作，更奖励精准操作

observation.zh: 指南提醒出弯给油时车尾可能突发滑动，雨地和旧胎更需留意。
observation.en: The guide flags power-on exit snaps, especially in rain or on worn tires.

exercise.zh: 比较新旧胎下的给油坡度，优先找到不用反复修方向的加速方式。
exercise.en: Compare throttle ramps on fresh and worn tires, aiming for acceleration without repeated corrections.

strength.zh: 前端响应敏锐，变向能力强
strength.en: responsive front end and strong change of direction

caution.zh: 灵活性要求克制而精准的转向输入

observation.zh: 官方车型页将 GMR-001 收录为 Hypercar 级别车型。

exercise.zh: 固定设置练习连续变向，比较减少方向修正后能否稳定保留出口速度。

strength.zh: 非混合动力输出直接，直线效率实用

caution.zh: 低速转向需要耐心控制循迹刹车

observation.zh: 官方车型页将 SCG 007 收录为非混合动力 LMH。

strength.zh: 高速平台稳定，动力输出渐进

observation.zh: 官方车型页将 Tipo 6 收录为 Hypercar 级别车型。

strength.zh: 转向活跃，中速响应强

exercise.en: Test lift-off rotation and exit throttle separately rather than changing both phases at once.

strength.zh: 现代化空气动力学套件灵活

caution.zh: 平衡对调校（setup）和路肩使用敏感

observation.zh: 指南认为车头未转好就给油会加重推头，迫使二次收油。

exercise.zh: 在同一弯延后一点给油，检查是否减少二次收油并改善出口位置。
exercise.en: Delay throttle slightly at one corner and check whether it reduces second lifts and improves exit position.

strength.zh: 操作窗口（operating window）宽广，容易上手

exercise.zh: 先降低入口速度，比较是否更早稳定给油；单独练习识别并释放锁死。
exercise.en: Reduce entry speed and compare how soon stable acceleration becomes possible; separately practice lockup recognition and release.
